nodeGroups.name: backfill
nodeGroups.description: Fetches published posts so the #cover-filter / #graph-filter ones go through the filter (always draft)

nodeGroups.name: filter-and-upload
nodeGroups.description: Tagged posts whose current image is neither an original nor a filtered one in the table: claim a row, filter, upload

nodeGroups.name: apply-or-log
nodeGroups.description: Draft: only fills the row. Otherwise swaps the featured image with a fresh updated_at and marks the row applied

activeVersion.name: Process drafts on edit, claim rows, retries
activeVersion.description: Runs on post.published and post.edited. Skips by image URL (original or filtered) instead of post id, claims a row before processing so repeated saves do not process twice, reads updated_at right before the update, retries network steps.
